subject: James, second continuity delta on Ziggy's direction: the mentor who introduced the teachings; a Nagual as well, always present; brother loosely (adopted, not blood); the personal source kept out of published lore
body:
Ziggy, in the session by voice at about 05:35 UTC, gave the backstory behind James: drawn a little from his own life, a mentor he looks to as a father figure and the one who introduced him to the Castaneda teachings, which is why the teachings are written on James; bring it into the story as much as possible; Jet is more of a MacGuffin who pops up, James can always be there, James is a Nagual as well; James looks nothing like Lisan, so he is adopted in a sense, brother loosely, not blood. The writer's delta: CHARACTER_JAMES_DELTA_2_20261014.md, sha256 f124641c2a14fe4ce2a5bc3026c95857a7d0eeb569c6a42664215935f462b96c, 5,044 bytes (DECISIONS item 59; open item 24; open item 23's story option answered).

For your lanes and Site Nova's: (1) the personal source is recorded in substance only, the real person unnamed and never a character, and the writer's default is that it stays in the record and out of any published storyboard text; please do not expose that paragraph on the site unless Ziggy says so. (2) Continuity changes, all proposed: the James note's "two sons of one mother" is withdrawn (not blood, so the sign was never his); James introduced Lisan to the teachings and the ink is his teaching text; James is the human Nagual always present and Jet the messenger from outside (the October 9 Jet record unchanged); Angels raised him and James taught him, two fathers for two halves; James the first Panhandler; James present throughout the episodes, including Story 01's fire. (3) Nothing changes in the adoption record, the ink file (rev 2 stands), the derivative's status or any lane; no image requested.

attachments.description: James, second delta: the mentor, the chosen brother, a Nagual as well; the personal source kept in the record only.
